title: It’s goodnight Vienna as Paris sleeper train to Austria and Berlin hit by cuts
summary: Some Nightjet services suspended from mid-December after French withdrawal amid public budget crisis Night train services linking Paris, Berlin and Vienna are to end from mid-December because of the French government’s withdrawal of funding, the Austrian national rail operator has said, in a blow to sleeper travel on important European routes. ÖBB, the largest provider of such trains in Europe, has led a drive to revive a once popular form of low-emission transport as an alternative to flying. Continue reading...
